A veche [ a ] was a popular assembly among some Slavic peoples during the Middle Ages . The veche is mentioned during the times of Kievan Rus' , and it later became a powerful institution in Russian cities such as Novgorod and Pskov . [ 1 ] [ 2 ] [ 3 ] In these cities, the veche acquired great prominence and was broadly comparable to the Norse thing or the Swiss Landsgemeinde . [ 4 ] The last veche meeting was held in Pskov in 1510, when the institution was abolished as part of the growing centralization of power in Russia. [ 5 ] [ 6 ]
